author: opencode-worker-2
text: Worker-2 analysis (released per context budget): the GatewaySfTracker and make_assigned_sf_option are defined in lichen-core/sf_assignment.rs but have zero production callers. To wire them: (1) Add GatewaySfTracker to the root's state (GatewayCoordinator or RplNode in router.rs) — the root tracks which nodes are assigned which SFs; (2) On node join (DAO receipt or beacon acceptance), call assign_sf(iid) and persist the mapping; (3) In build_dio (router.rs:822) or the gateway DIO serialization path (rpl_root.c on the C side), append the 3-byte TLV [0x14, 1, assigned_sf] after the DODAG Config and SCHC Rule Version options; (4) Test: build a DIO with the option, parse it back, assert the assigned SF matches. The tracker and option codec are already unit-tested in sf_assignment.rs — only the wiring is missing. Recommend a fresh-context worker handles this (it requires understanding the full DIO construction pipeline across lichen-node/router.rs and lichen-gateway/rpl_root.c).
